subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the official Google Chat plugin support delegated user OAuth, and if so should it use an interactive per-user grant or administrator-controlled domain-wide delegation for outbound reactions, native uploads, and email-address DM lookup?
rationale: This choice determines credential custody, Workspace consent, sender identity, tenant scope, onboarding, and which operations may safely fall back to app authentication.

options.title: Sponsor delegated auth
options.body: Adopt a plugin-owned, SecretRef-backed delegated-auth design with explicit scopes, identity attribution, revocation, and phased capability rollout.

options.title: Keep app auth only
options.body: Retain service-account authentication and make unsupported reactions, uploads, and alias lookups unavailable with reliable text-link and message-typing fallbacks.

options.title: External OAuth variant
options.body: Keep the official plugin conservative and let a separately maintained Google Chat plugin variant own delegated credentials and higher-risk operations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor delegated auth
recommendation.body: Adopt a plugin-owned, SecretRef-backed delegated-auth design with explicit scopes, identity attribution, revocation, and phased capability rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: They committed the original channel, remain active in its auth path, and already reviewed this issue's unresolved product and security direction.
